fda.text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. If pregnant or breast-feeding , ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children.

summary: Phenacetin was removed from the market in the United States and 36 other nations starting in 1965 because of blood harm and kidney damage, also called nephrotoxicity [3]. Official warnings state to keep this product away from children, consult a health worker before using it if you are pregnant or nursing, and seek immediate poison control or medical help if an overdose occurs [5]. Based on a small computer model rather than human testing, the drug received low risk scores for both liver and heart harm [M].
